common: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production city-building parcel asset, landscape 2.3:1, high bird-eye FRONT orthographic camera. Municipality reference is lighting/material/framing only; replace architecture entirely. Warm upper-left sunlight, ivory limestone, terracotta, lead grey, olive/cypress green, restrained realistic painterly texture. Fill all four image edges with real building and integral functional paved courtyard; no margin, white border, transparency, empty soil, surrounding roads/city, text/UI or reused twin-tower gate. Whole roof, walls, courtyard and shadows remain inside canvas. Distinct mobile-readable silhouette. Runtime maps the entire texture into measured trapezoid plot corners.

subjects.hamam: Low bathhouse domes with star skylights, cooling pools, no minarets or palace towers.
subjects.medrese: Madrasa with large rooftop brass telescope, books, astronomical instruments, no mosque dome or minarets.
subjects.muze: Long archaeology exhibition facade, gable roof, sculptures, columns and amphorae.
subjects.kahvehane: Low timber/stone coffee pavilion, copper vents, striped terrace canopy and brewing station.
subjects.saray: Three-storey marble imperial residence, hipped roofs, balconies, terraces and formal fountain garden, no mosque domes.
subjects.tekke: Green-roof octagonal timber semahane, humble lodging wings, whirling dervishes.
subjects.gozlukcu: Open-front lens grinding workshop, brass spectacles icon sign, magnifiers and optical benches.
subjects.ticaret_merkezi: Two-storey merchant hall, projecting timber windows, goods, large brass weighing scale and market tower, no domes.
